messages.content: Plan a 5 day road trip from Lisbon to Porto for me (Ana) and Marco in late June. We'll rent a Toyota RAV4 hybrid. Budget is about €1,200 excluding flights.

content.text: Classic coastal route: Sintra, Óbidos, Nazaré, Coimbra, then Porto. Check the driving distance and typical June weather first. Maybe also consider Aveiro but it could be too much for 5 days.

messages.name: maps_route
messages.content:
Total distance 412 km, driving time 5h 10m.
Lisbon → Sintra 28 km
Sintra → Óbidos 72 km
Óbidos → Nazaré 45 km
Nazaré → Coimbra 110 km
Coimbra → Porto 123 km
Tolls approx €38.

messages.name: weather_lookup
messages.content: Lisbon in June: average high 26°C, low 17°C, 1 rainy day, sea 18°C.

content.text:
Here's a relaxed plan (≈412 km, 5 h of driving in total):

Day 1 – Pick up the RAV4 at Lisbon airport, drive to Sintra (Pena Palace, Quinta da Regaleira).

Day 2 – Óbidos walled town, then Nazaré for the giant-wave cliffs and grilled sardines.

Day 3 – Coimbra: the university library (Biblioteca Joanina) and fado in the evening.

Day 4 – Porto: Ribeira, Livraria Lello, port cellars in Vila Nova de Gaia.

Day 5 – Douro Valley day trip, return the car in Porto.

Rough costs for two: car hire €260, fuel €55, tolls €38, hotels €520, food €300 → about €1,173.

messages.content: Can you find a hotel in Porto near Ribeira for the last two nights?

content.text: Search near Ribeira, 2 nights from 25 June, keep under €130/night to stay within budget.

messages.name: hotel_search
messages.content:
Pestana Vintage Porto – €128/night – Ribeira riverside – rating 4.6
Casa da Companhia – €142/night – Baixa – rating 4.8
Guest House Douro – €119/night – Ribeira – rating 4.7

content.text: Guest House Douro (€119/night, rating 4.7) is right on the Ribeira waterfront and keeps you under budget. Pestana Vintage Porto is a good backup at €128.
